newsitem.title: USA: Digital declines comment on Intel.
newsitem.headline: Digital declines comment on Intel.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp declined comment Friday on a report that it recently held talks with Intel Corp about a possible settlement of Digital's patent-infringement lawsuit against Intel.
"No comment," Digital spokesman Dan Kaferle said.
The Wall Street Journal reported that top executives of the two companies held preliminary talks in mid-June that failed to produce any agreement to try to settle the suit.

Unnamed sources told the Journal that Digital sought a settlement that would give the computer maker benefits on future Intel chip production. Digital Chief Executive Robert Palmer also raised the possibility of royalties, cross-licensing agreements on a new chip that Intel is developing, or a combination of the two, the Journal said.
Digital's suit, filed in federal court in Worcester, Mass., in May, accuses Intel of stealing key elements of its patented technology for the design of Pentium processors.
